# Paddltir

> Dragon boat crew management for coaches, sweeps, and club organisers.
> Build rosters, seat boats heat by heat, and check trim and side balance
> before you push off. Web app at https://app.paddltir.com —
> sign in with email or Google on first visit.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](https://paddltir.com/llms-full.txt): product copy and main pages as a single markdown file
- [Docs](https://paddltir.com/docs): feature reference — lineups, rosters, trim and balance
- [About](https://paddltir.com/about): who builds Paddltir and why
- [FAQ](https://paddltir.com/faq): rosters, crewlists, trim, privacy, and getting started
- [Compare](https://paddltir.com/compare): paper roster vs spreadsheet vs Paddltir
- [GitHub](https://github.com/junlee-3/paddltir-web): marketing site source

## App

- Web app: https://app.paddltir.com
- Sign in with email or Google — account created on first visit
- Works in any modern browser on desktop or mobile

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://paddltir.com/privacy): what we store about your account and crew data
- [Terms](https://paddltir.com/terms): including proprietary copyright and licence terms
